result.brief: 提出关系优先的潜在动作预训练框架，先建模视觉转移关系再抽象为状态条件随机潜在动作，并通过动作条件潜在动力学学习其预测效果，用于规划与策略监督。
result.reason: Learns latent action representations from unlabeled video via relation modeling and action-conditioned latent dynamics, a video representation contribution; experiments are embodied planning/control.
